# Exxon Valdez Trustee Council Hydrocarbon Database (EVTHD, 2014 version), CSV export

Fetched 14 Nov 2026 by `scripts/download_evthd_goa.sh` from the Gulf of Alaska Data Portal record on DataONE
("Analysis of hydrocarbons following the Exxon Valdez oil spill, Gulf of Alaska, 1989-2014", PID urn:uuid:3249ada0-afe3-4dd6-875e-0f7928a4c171, member node urn:node:GOA).
Each file checked against the SHA-1 DataONE publishes. Licence: see `metadata_EML.xml` (not interpreted here).
This is the CSV form of the database (sediment, tissue, seawater; 63 hydrocarbons; 1989-2014). It is NOT the Access file listed on NOAA InPort 17283
(InPort returned HTTP 503/403 to scripts on 14 Nov 2026; the InPort record was not reached). The record's three R helper scripts returned HTTP 404 and are not included.
Not read or cleaned by this agent.
